title: Passive to Active Voice: More Practice — Quiz 113
content:
## Passive to Active Voice: More Practice

Convert passive sentences by identifying the person doing the action.

### Lesson focus

1. Lockdown had been extended till June 8 (by the govt).
2. NCERT has been asked by the Child Commission to delete “chokri” from a Hindi text book.
3. Every Indian will be vaccinated by December (by the govt).

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
